author: Jad Yehya
name: PR #2135 + MP3 marker-pair fusion + adaptive n-gram + gated XSA residual candidate
technique_summary: PR #2158 MP3 marker-pair fusion on the PR #2135 frontier stack, plus adaptive token-only n-gram boost scaling and a zero-init per-head gated residual scale on the XSA self-value projection subtraction. ADAPTIVE_NGRAM_GAMMA=1.0 keeps the same prefix-only hint and closed-form normalization while reducing boost when the model already agrees. GATED_XSA_RESIDUAL=1 keeps step-0 behavior identical to the MP3/#2135 XSA path because the scale is 1 + tanh(0).
